items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Not Step ‘n’ Fetchit, Snake Hips Tucker.

ctx.x: Some of the non-musical flourishes that you incorporate into your act, the hip shaking and all, does that go back to vaudeville influences, not necessarily with you…
It could be. We learned about Chippy Hill and Step ‘n’ Fetchit. Not Step ‘n’ Fetchit, Snake Hips Tucker.

That long tradition of vaudeville performance and entertainers, even going into Armstrong and Dizzy Gillespie, the clowning…tell me about those performance aspects with some of the vocal impersonations, could you tell me about that?
